attribution.title: Rembrandtmonument - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Louis Royer (1852); figure reconstructed from photographs by Elekes Andor, Yair Haklai, Владимир Шеляпин, Julien Chatelain from Paris, France
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Rembrandtplein (11).jpg" by Elekes Andor (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rembrandtplein_(11).jpg); "Louis Royer-Rembrandt-Amsterdam.jpg" by Yair Haklai (CC BY-SA 3.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Louis_Royer-Rembrandt-Amsterdam.jpg); "Rembrandt.JPG" by Владимир Шеляпин (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rembrandt.JPG); "Rembrandt (42707741651).jpg" by Julien Chatelain from Paris, France (CC BY-SA 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rembrandt_(42707741651).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model.
